name: @arena/expert-calibration-service
description: Arena expert-calibration reference service (Work Order C004; issue #111). In-process orchestration over @arena/expert-calibration: calibration program lifecycle (register/record-outcome/run-verdict), pre-training tracks derived from the C003 intake gap-list and dispatched to the A017 workbench surface, and scheduled requalification checks as durable idempotent jobs on the A015 job fabric (@arena/job-protocol JobRecords) — all over an in-memory reference store with injected ports (the A015-fabric house pattern for reference services). Submissions hand proposals to the PUBLIC ports (the C003 intake gap source, the A007 qualification proposal port, the A017 workbench assignment port) — never direct writes into another surface's state. Commands carry REQUIRED idempotency keys; cross-tenant reads fail closed; tampered store entries fail closed; the C002 routing engine consumes the demonstrated-performance read surface (a port, not a write into routing); calibration is measurement DATA, never an authorization (lock rules 9/35).
